page.layout: One column of running text, set in full width. Below the text at the right: a catchword and a gathering signature. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: Historia Concilij Florentini, quasi de Romanis Pontificibus triumphasset Photius, nimbos Septentrionis profundit: Et quid si mille Papæ Photium incursassent [?], seu Laicum, seu sacratum, seu vivum, seu mortuum? Photius non minus sui juris securus sedebat in solio a Paparum contumeliis, dum vixit, quam post mortem supinus iacebat in sepulchro. Jam mundus aetate proiectior vindicias dedit secundum libertatem; & mortales plurimi a Photij exemplo didicere, istos Salmoneas contemnere, qui tonitrua excitant in maiorem strepitum, quam stragem. Fulgur discurrens multa terri-tat animalia, sed rarum cadit bidental. Et esse ne mentis integrae dicendus est hic vir? Ad incursandum Photium non fuere necessarij mille Papae. Quatuor nec illi coniunctim, sed unus post alium subsecutis temporibus in Romana cathedra confidentes, Nicolaus, Adrianus, Joannes, Marinus astum Photij, & immensam improbitatem, nec non Imperatorum, & Principum fauorem, & gratiam compresserunt, eumque de throno malis artibus occupato deiectum, in numerum sceleratorum, & impiorum hominum detrusum, & uti a Gregorio Syracusano ad sacros ordines promotum, laicum declaratum, a solo patrio extorrem, vagum, exulemque aberrare, dignitatibus

page.notes: Page is a single column; the first line "Historia Concilij Florentini" is set at the head of the text block flush with the body, and the sentence continues, so it is read as text, not as a running head. The first paragraph continues from the previous page (cont="true"). Doubtful readings: "incursassent" (long-s letters hard to separate) is marked [?]; "Syracusano" read from "Syraeufano" as printed; "astum" read as printed. Italic is applied to the opening sentence "Et quid si ... mortuum?". The text ends mid-sentence with "dignitatibus" on a full line, and the catchword "im-" stands below it.
